response.rationale: Sickle cell maculopathy specifically matches the macular ischemic whitening and OCT findings of INL/OPL hyperreflective plaques with subsequent middle retinal atrophy, while sickle cell retinopathy is broader and less specific to the macular localization.

rejected.why: General sickle cell retinopathy, not specific to the macular findings described.
No diabetes history or typical diabetic retinopathy features; sickle cell disease is the primary condition.
Absence of cherry-red spot and normal arteriolar filling contradict central retinal artery occlusion.
Retinal ischemia is a descriptive term, not a specific diagnosis; sickle cell maculopathy is the precise entity.
